articles.summary: Rapid7 Intelligence tracked a set of Linux samples that blend into the software and device conventions of the telecom environments they target. The set spans a newly observed BPFDoor variant, a BPF Rekoobe build seen against South Korean targets, a dropper, and six builds of a Linux implant deployed against Taiwanese appliances.
articles.title: SMTP is the key: BPFDoor and AVERAT hitting the network edge

articles.summary: Agent-to-agent security is still evolving, but security teams can begin preparing now by extending principles they already understand across identity, access, visibility, and detection. And as agent adoption grows, organizations will also need to make these interactions visible as part of normal security operations. Get the basics in a new blog.
articles.title: Securing Agent-to-Agent Communication: The Next Identity Frontier

articles.summary: A brand new Gartner® report examines the roles and capabilities that SOCs are expected to require as AI becomes further embedded in operations. Rapid7 is offering complimentary access to the research, which we believe can help leaders plan their future workforce, operating model, and investment priorities.
articles.title: How AI Is Changing the Roles Required in the Security Operations Center

articles.summary: As automated exploits dismantle traditional defense models in hours, Rapid7 unites threat intelligence, vulnerability research, and Rapid7 Labs to end reactive cybersecurity once and for all.
articles.title: Rapid7 Launches Rapid7 Intelligence to Harness Threat Data Against Attackers

articles.summary: ASOS customers recently opened their phones to find a hostile push notification delivered through the retailer’s own app. So what happens when an attacker can communicate through a channel customers already trust?
articles.title: The ASOS incident: When attackers use the channels customers trust
